profile_text.body:
WeRide Inc. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou that develops autonomous driving technology, according to its own site. It describes itself as a commercial-stage global company working on autonomous driving from Level 2 to Level 4, built around a universal platform it calls WeRide One, a self-developed foundational toolchain, and accumulated real-world operational data. The company says its business footprint spans more than 60 cities across 13 countries and that it offers a portfolio of five core products, including Robotaxi.

WeRide is listed on Nasdaq under the ticker WRD and on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under 0800. The company also states that it has been recognized on Fortune's 2026 Change the World and 2025 Future 50 lists. It is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001867729, and its shares also appear under the name WERIDE INC-ADR.

No litigation or MCP server records are held for the company, and no individual products are tracked in the current record beyond the five core products the site refers to as a group.
